'''Arthur Tovmasyan''' ({{langx|hy|Արթուր Թովմասյան}}; born 2 December 1962) is an Artsakhi politician who was the [[President of the National Assembly of Artsakh|President]] of the [[National Assembly (Artsakh)|National Assembly]] of the [[List of states with limited recognition|breakaway state]] of the [[Republic of Artsakh]] from 21 May 2020 to 7 August 2023.<ref>{{cite news|title=Bako Sahakyan hosted delegation of Armenian National Assembly|url=http://times.am/?p=19068&l=en|accessdate=3 March 2013|newspaper=Times.am|date=20 February 2013}}</ref>
